tools.name: search
tools.description: Search across entities, politicians, contracts, grants, organs, and persons. Returns top matches with type, name, slug/id, and a short context line.

tools.name: list_filter_options
tools.description: Enumerate all valid filter values the other tools accept: departments, organs, finalitats, parties, comarques, vegueríes, beneficiary types, procedure types.

tools.name: get_dataset_stats
tools.description: Global counts, EUR totals, and last-sync metadata across grants, contracts, entities, and persons.

tools.name: get_entity
tools.description: Full entity profile plus Menjometre scores with natural-language explanations. Accepts slug or CIF. Returns null if entity is anonymised or missing.

tools.name: get_entity_grants
tools.description: Grants awarded to the entity with filters (year range, min amount, department) and cursor pagination.

tools.name: get_entity_contracts
tools.description: Contracts awarded to the entity with filters (year, min amount, organ, sole-source flag).

tools.name: get_entity_financials
tools.description: Yearly financial timeline filed with the Generalitat registry of entities.

tools.name: get_entity_risk_analysis
tools.description: Aggregated risk dossier: concentration, recurrence, sole-source, fragmentation, dependency, accountability — with textual interpretation per axis.

tools.name: get_rankings
tools.description: Parameterised top-N ranking across entities. `metric` ∈ total_public_funds | menjometre_score | total_grants | total_contracts | sole_source_pct | grant_dependency_pct. Filters: comarca, beneficiary_type, org_type, min_funds.

tools.name: compare_entities
tools.description: Side-by-side comparison of 2–5 entities (slug or CIF).

tools.name: get_politician
tools.description: Profile, accumulated years, party, institution, salary, BORME vincles count.

tools.name: get_politician_salary_history
tools.description: Detailed salary time-series across positions.

tools.name: list_carrecs
tools.description: Positions filtered by institution, party, active status.

tools.name: get_party
tools.description: Party aggregates: member count, total accumulated years, average salary.

tools.name: get_politica_hub
tools.description: Global political dashboard: counts by institution, top earners, data coverage, last sync.

tools.name: get_porta_giratoria
tools.description: Revolving door catalog. Filters: party, institution, min years of political service before pivot, sector.

tools.name: get_politician_conflicts
tools.description: Declared + detected conflicts for one politician.

tools.name: get_entity_conflicts
tools.description: Entity-side mirror of conflict detection — politicians linked to the entity.

tools.name: analyze_conflict_of_interest
tools.description: Given a person name and an entity identifier, return every known link (BORME role, political position, declarations, grants received while in office, contracts, lobby meetings).

tools.name: detect_undisclosed_conflicts
tools.description: Proactive scan: politicians with BORME roles in entities receiving grants/contracts during their term but with no matching declaration.

tools.name: get_lobby_meetings
tools.description: Lobby meetings from the Generalitat transparency portal. Filters: official name, interest group, date range.

tools.name: get_organ
tools.description: Single contracting body profile: total contracts, total amount, % sole-source, % menor, % competitive, top-5 suppliers share.

tools.name: list_organs
tools.description: Contracting bodies catalog with filters (semaphore, search) and pagination.

tools.name: get_ens_public
tools.description: Instrumental/public body profile including type (consorci, empresa pública, fundació) and parent administration.

tools.name: list_ens_publics
tools.description: Instrumental public entities catalog filtered by type/comarca.

tools.name: get_pressupostos_hub
tools.description: Generalitat budget dashboard for a single fiscal year: total, by department, execution rate if available.

tools.name: get_budget_by_department
tools.description: Budget series by department with nominal or CPI-deflated (real) values.

tools.name: get_budget_partides
tools.description: Line items within a department + year.

tools.name: get_efficiency_analysis
tools.description: Cost-per-outcome analysis for selected programmes (EUR spent ÷ outputs where available).

tools.name: get_fiscal_deficit
tools.description: Catalonia → Spain fiscal deficit for a year range using one of three academic methods: cash_flow | burden_benefit | contribution_cost.

tools.name: get_budget_transfers
tools.description: Admin → entity transfer flows with filters.

tools.name: get_yearly_trends_budget
tools.description: Generic time-series of a budget dimension/metric (deflated or nominal).

tools.name: get_xarxa_stats
tools.description: Global network metrics: node counts, edge counts, connectivity, top hubs.

tools.name: get_xarxa_by_comarca
tools.description: Geographic breakdown of network density (edges per comarca).

tools.name: get_person_network
tools.description: BFS from a single person up to a max depth (hard-capped at 3).

tools.name: get_entity_network
tools.description: BFS from a single entity up to a max depth (hard-capped at 3).

tools.name: find_shortest_path
tools.description: Bounded BFS shortest path between two graph nodes. Max depth hard-capped at 5 in the RPC.

tools.name: get_network_hubs
tools.description: Highest-degree nodes filtered by type + metric.

tools.name: detect_clusters
tools.description: Louvain communities computed nightly. Returns the top clusters by size.

tools.name: investigate_cluster
tools.description: Full member list of a Louvain cluster with entity + person joins.

tools.name: analyze_contract_network
tools.description: Contract graph for an organ or entity: sole-source patterns, repeat suppliers, fragmentation signals.

tools.name: get_equivalencies
tools.description: Translate a EUR amount into public-service equivalents (teachers, nurses, daycare places, etc.).

tools.name: get_yearly_trends
tools.description: Generic yearly time-series by dimension/metric (grants, contracts, entities).

tools.name: export_data
tools.description: Bulk JSON export of grants/contracts/entities with filters. CSV is emitted as plain text for LLM consumption.

tools.name: get_methodology
tools.description: Scoring methodology, data sources, last-sync timestamps, definitions. Citable for LLM outputs.

tools.name: get_source_documents
tools.description: Enumerate every source URL attached to a single record. record_type ∈ grant | contract | conveni | politician_position | porta_giratoria_case | personal_eventual_appointment | official_appointment | entity.

tools.name: list_documents_for_entity
tools.description: Every source document linked to any record touching the given entity.

tools.name: fetch_source_document
tools.description: Server-side retrieval of an allowlisted source URL. Extracts plain text (first 64 kB) via pdf-parse/readability. SSRF-hardened. 24h cached. URL MUST exist in the DB allowlist.
